Boiling Slug.name: Boiling Slug
Boiling Slug.description: The user packs a liter of steaming water between both palms and fires it across a room as a dense slug, half the range of a pure Water user's shot. It deals heavy bludgeoning and fire damage, splashes around a raised shield and knocks the target flat; held back, the user vents the heat from their wrists first so the slug strikes warm without scalding, though that steam clouds their own view. Strain: heavy.
